verses.12:20: وَشَرَوۡهُ بِثَمَنِۭ بَخۡسࣲ دَرَٰهِمَ مَعۡدُودَةࣲ وَكَانُواْ فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلزَّٰهِدِينَ

meaning: The root "zhd" primarily means to abstain from something, to relinquish or forsake it, often referring to worldly things.
